Product.title: Product
Product.description: One traded pair, and the increments an order on it has to respect.

id.description: Product id, such as `BTC-USD`. This is what every other endpoint here takes.

base_currency.description: What is being bought and sold, such as `BTC`.

quote_currency.description: What it is priced in, such as `USD`.

quote_increment.description: Smallest price movement. Prices are strings on the wire and decimals here: a price is money, and money through a float is a bug waiting for a rounding.

min_market_funds.description: Smallest quote-currency amount a market order may spend.

status_message.description: Why, when the status is not `online`. Empty otherwise.

margin_enabled.description: Whether margin trading is available on this product.

post_only.description: Only maker orders are accepted right now.

limit_only.description: Only limit orders are accepted right now.

cancel_only.description: Only cancels are accepted right now.

trading_disabled.description: Trading is halted on this product.

fx_stablecoin.description: Whether this is a stablecoin-to-fiat pair, which is priced differently.

auction_mode.description: Whether the product is currently in an auction rather than continuous trading.

max_slippage_percentage.description: Largest slippage a market order will be filled through.

trade_id.description: Monotonically increasing id, per product. Newest first, and the cursor the walk pages by.

side.description: Side of the *maker* order, which is the opposite of the taker's. A `sell` here is a taker buying into a resting sell.

size.description: Amount filled, in the base currency.

price.description: Price filled at, in the quote currency.

Candle.title: Candle
Candle.description: One OHLC bucket, as a fixed six-column row rather than an object. The order is the exchange's own and is not the usual one: low and high come before open and close.

prefixItems.title: low
prefixItems.description: Lowest price in the bucket. A bare number here, unlike every price elsewhere in this API, which is a decimal string.

prefixItems.title: volume
prefixItems.description: Base-currency volume traded in the bucket.
